name: PDF 页面渲染与有界 OCR
eligibility_checks: Poppler pdftoppm and pdfinfo are installed
Tesseract languages exist when OCR is requested
human_gates: confirm explicit pages or bounded sampling strategy
semantically review rendered pages or OCR candidates before content claims
evidence_requirements: OCR output hash when OCR runs
allowed_claims: the selected PDF page rendered or produced the recorded OCR candidate under the declared parameters
forbidden_claims: sampled pages represent the full PDF
OCR or rendering is semantic review
a failed page may be silently omitted
